payload.claim: The Notes section states the fix "measured 164 changed tokens with the size gate... under the bug ceiling of 1300," attributing this to four lines in session.py and one new test in tests/test_session.py. The size gate's actual behavior excludes diffs under the repo's declared test_paths (tests/** per .saffron/policy.yaml:70) from the ceiling-relevant count, reporting them separately as "not counted." So the 164 figure, if it includes the new test's tokens, isn't quite the number the gate would compare to the ceiling, though this is cosmetic since the real gated figure is smaller still and the ceiling is respected either way.
